> A live demonstration node of the AgenticSystemCore reference engine — the second node of the Agentic Knowledge Web — running on a small sample of well-known agent-system patterns.

## Advanced Architectures

- [The Deep Research Loop](https://patterns.agenticsystemcore.com/concepts/deep-research-loop/): Split a question into parts, search them in parallel, combine the findings and check that every claim has a source.

## Anti-Patterns

- [Unbounded Loops](https://patterns.agenticsystemcore.com/concepts/unbounded-agent-loops/): An agent loop with no step limit, no budget and no independent exit test runs until money, patience or the platform stops it.

## Classical Foundations

- [Saga for Agent Workflows](https://patterns.agenticsystemcore.com/concepts/saga-for-agents/): Give each important agent step an undo action, so a failed multi-step run can be rolled back instead of left half done.

## Cognitive & Behavioral

- [Metacognitive Monitoring and Control](https://patterns.agenticsystemcore.com/concepts/metacognitive-monitoring/): A meta level watches how sure the agent is while it works and decides to continue, retry or abstain.

## Data & Retrieval

- [Retrieval Evaluation](https://patterns.agenticsystemcore.com/concepts/retrieval-evaluation/): Measure whether retrieval found the right material separately from whether the answer used it faithfully.

## Ethics & Sustainability

- [Meaningful Human Control](https://patterns.agenticsystemcore.com/concepts/meaningful-human-control/): Two conditions for real human control: the system responds to relevant human reasons, and its actions trace to a person who understands it.

## Evaluation & Testing

- [Trajectory and Outcome Evaluation](https://patterns.agenticsystemcore.com/concepts/trajectory-vs-outcome-evals/): Grade the end state an agent produced and the path it took as two separate questions, each with a suitable grader.

## Foundational

- [Agents as Tools](https://patterns.agenticsystemcore.com/concepts/agents-as-tools/): Wrap a specialist agent as a tool, so a calling agent can hand it one bounded task and keep control.
- [Parallelization](https://patterns.agenticsystemcore.com/concepts/parallelization/): Run independent subtasks at once and combine the results, either by splitting the work or by running the same task several times.

## Future Research

- [Weak-to-Strong Oversight](https://patterns.agenticsystemcore.com/concepts/weak-to-strong-oversight/): Open question: can weaker judges, human or model, reliably oversee agents stronger than themselves? What is known and what is not.

## Governance & Accountability

- [Tamper-Evident Agent Audit Log](https://patterns.agenticsystemcore.com/concepts/immutable-audit-log/): An append-only, hash-linked record of every important agent action, so what happened can be rebuilt and checked.

## Memory & Cognition

- [Skill-Library Compounding](https://patterns.agenticsystemcore.com/concepts/skill-library/): Store verified procedures so an agent's skills build up across tasks instead of being rediscovered every run.

## Operations & Reliability

- [Exception Handling and Recovery](https://patterns.agenticsystemcore.com/concepts/exception-handling-and-recovery/): Classify each failure, retry short faults with limits, switch route for lasting ones, and report reduced results honestly.

## Product Practice

- [The Autonomy Ladder](https://patterns.agenticsystemcore.com/concepts/autonomy-ladder/): A six-level scale for how much an agent may decide alone, chosen per kind of action from risk, not from model capability.

## Protocols & Interop

- [Sustainability Signal Plane](https://patterns.agenticsystemcore.com/concepts/sustainability-signal-plane/): A well-known URI where a system publishes its energy and carbon figures, and reads its peers' figures as input to its decisions.

## Reasoning & Decision

- [Goal Setting and Monitoring](https://patterns.agenticsystemcore.com/concepts/goal-setting-and-monitoring/): Give an agent a goal with checkable criteria, then monitor its progress and decide to continue, re-plan or stop.

## Reference Architectures

- [Generative Agents](https://patterns.agenticsystemcore.com/concepts/generative-agents/): A simulated character with a full memory record, reflection over it, and plans drawn from both, so it stays consistent over days.

## Agentic SDLC

- [Plan Approval Gate](https://patterns.agenticsystemcore.com/concepts/plan-approval-gate/): The agent researches and proposes a plan without editing anything; a person approves, changes or rejects it before any edit.

## Security

- [Dual-LLM Pattern](https://patterns.agenticsystemcore.com/concepts/dual-llm-pattern/): Keep the model that can act away from untrusted text: a tool-less model reads it, and plain code passes results between them.
- [OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications](https://patterns.agenticsystemcore.com/concepts/owasp-agentic-top-10/): OWASP's list of ten security risks for agents that act, a shared vocabulary for threat models and security reviews.

## Specs & Requirements

- [Specification Gaming](https://patterns.agenticsystemcore.com/concepts/specification-gaming/): Agents optimise the criterion you wrote, not the result you meant; the gap between the two is where failures hide.

## Multi-Agent Topologies

- [Blackboard](https://patterns.agenticsystemcore.com/concepts/blackboard/): Independent specialists work on one problem through a shared workspace; a control step picks who contributes next.
